script_text: The veil between worlds just thinned. From this moment, your soul companions are whispering clearer than ever, especially through dreams and synchronicities, guiding career shifts and romantic encounters aligned to your true nature. On July 24, Neptune forms a trine to the North Node, opening a karmic doorway to encounter your Power Animal — the force that has always been guarding the 10th House of your public destiny. But beware the Shadow Side: if you ignore these messages, Chiron retrograding in the 1st House demands a painful awakening, forcing you to confront the wounds that block your spiritual voice. Your spirit totem urges you to honor the quiet, instinctive pull toward the right path, because the universe mirrors your inner wildlife externally now. Survival Tip: Create a sacred space tonight, light sage, and journal the first animal image that comes to mind — this is your guide for the coming month. Comment below to claim your decoded message and deepen your cosmic alignment. The stars have spoken.
